extension.summary: Free German and U.S. live TV, local channels, sports schedules and classic films
Freies deutsches und US-Live-TV, lokale Sender, Sportpläne und Filmklassiker
extension.description: Kodaches gathers free, publicly available live TV in one place: German TV, U.S. TV, local Texas and Dallas - Fort Worth stations, news, kids, music and free streaming services, with a Sports Center showing league schedules and live scores, and thousands of public-domain classic films. Works on its own; no account or server needed. Channels come from public lists of free-to-air streams; availability depends on the broadcasters.

Kodaches bündelt frei verfügbares Live-TV: deutsches und US-Fernsehen, lokale Sender aus Texas und Dallas - Fort Worth, Nachrichten, Kinder, Musik und kostenlose Streaming-Dienste, dazu ein Sportcenter mit Spielplänen und Live-Ergebnissen sowie Tausende gemeinfreie Filmklassiker. Funktioniert eigenständig, ohne Konto oder Server. Die Sender stammen aus öffentlichen Listen frei empfangbarer Streams; die Verfügbarkeit hängt von den Sendern ab.
extension.disclaimer: Kodaches does not host or provide any content. Channel availability depends on the broadcasters' public streams.
Kodaches hostet oder liefert keine Inhalte. Die Verfügbarkeit der Sender hängt von den öffentlichen Streams der Sender ab.
extension.news: 2.5.0: World News: 20 international news channels (Al Jazeera, BBC News, France 24, CNN International, NHK World, CBC, ABC Australia and more), only from the broadcasters' own servers. Channels start faster: Kodaches hands Kodi one quality of a channel instead of the whole list. Streaming apps in folders (TV & Movies, News, Sports, German TV, Kids, Music & Radio, Tools) with new official add-ons: Hulu, HBO Max, The Roku Channel, Crackle, Plex, NewsON, ARD/ZDF Mediathek, Arte, Trakt, Up Next, Backup, Radio, Mixcloud, Multi Weather (set as Kodi's weather provider) and more. Fix: channels in several languages (DW English, Spanish, Arabic) are no longer merged into one. 2.3.0: Pluto TV channels are no longer listed: their server refuses Kodi, so they only showed "Playback failed". Watch Pluto TV with the official Pluto TV add-on, now in Streaming apps with Samsung TV Plus and Plex Live (free, no account). The channel check now checks as Kodi, so channels Kodi cannot play are hidden. A channel list that fails to download is tried again at once and after 15 minutes, instead of leaving Local or Sports empty for hours. Older versions: kmwhite40.github.io/Kodaches-Installer/releases/

extension.description: Installs Kodaches and keeps it up to date through Kodi's own add-on updates. Also lists SlyGuy's official streaming-service add-ons.
Installiert Kodaches und hält es über Kodis eigene Add-on-Aktualisierung aktuell. Listet auch die offiziellen Streaming-Add-ons von SlyGuy.
